profile.headline: Cyber Software Engineer Principal at Lockheed Martin
profile.geoLocationName: Baltimore City County, Maryland, United States
profile.summary: Ms. Smith (PMP) brings over 36 years of experience to her role as a software developer, including over 11 years specializing in PeopleSoft implementation, upgrade, and support projects, as well as over 14 years as Project Manager and Tech Lead in charge of a Life Cycle Support Team, leader of new development efforts, and Deputy Program Manager/Program Manager for a $15-$20M/year contract. Her experience includes managing a team of software developers to execute major software upgrades, life cycle support (LCS) issues, team tasks, and project scheduling. Also managing future enhancement requirements and determining implementation timeframes based upon project schedules. Her experience and knowledge of Systems Implementation includes requirements definition, systems analysis and design, implementation, conversions, customizations, training, post implementation support, and upgrade processes. She has a solid foundation in the PeopleSoft Financial Suite with focus in the Purchasing and Inventory modules along with experience in the HR suite. She has experience with a 100% customized system developed specifically for a Department of Defense Agency utilizing the PeopleSoft/Oracle Toolset and java tools.

positions.description: Manage a program with between 85-100 employees valued at ~ $15M year. PMP Certified. Responsible for Managing between 10-15 Technical Task Orders on a yearly basis. positions.description: Continued previous role with TI Consulting as Deloitte acquired the small business. Managed 2 teams of software developers to provide custom application implementations of PeopleSoft and Java apps for a DoD Agency.

positions.title: Programmer/Team Lead
positions.description:
Developed software applications using PeopleSoft. Led a team of software developers to implement a custom application at a Government installation.
Responsibilities included requirements gathering, application design, development, system analysis, testing, implementation and enhancements for a 100% custom system consisting of 40+ PeopleSoft applications. The system is used for Access Control, Industrial Security, Foreign Travel, Clearance Processing, Access Management, Industrial Security, Badge Control, and many other functional areas.  It is highly integrated with other corporate systems. Conducted frequent application prototyping sessions with customer to ensure delivered product met customer expectations and technical requirements. Provided support to external Environment Support Team to ensure system was available to customers 24x7 with minimum disruptions. Utilized Oracle/PeopleSoft 8.4 development tools such as Application Designer, PeopleCode, Application Engine, XML Publisher, and SQR. Additional tools and languages included Mercury Quality Center, COGNOS, C, and SQL.
